## Blocking findings

1. **Validation remains serial.** The four kernels retain single-thread guards at `codegen.rs:1251`, `:1351`, `:1558`, and `:1662`. Backend launches still use `one` at `backend.rs:615`, `:685`, `:778`, and `:882`. Scalar loops also remain, e.g. `codegen.rs:1370-1373` and `:1589-1593`.

2. **The reduction suppresses errors.** `status[1]` resets to zero at `codegen.rs:1156`, so `atomicMin(status + 1, candidate)` at `:1966` cannot record any nonnegative candidate. The helper never sets `status[0]`, while the host only reports errors when `status[0] != 0` at `backend.rs:935`. Direct first-writer assignments also remain in target kernels.

3. **Required tests are absent and existing tests fail.** No emitted-source tests enforce criteria 2–4. Existing assertions fail at `codegen.rs:2283`, `:2367`, and `:2422`.

## Acceptance criteria

| # | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **FAIL** | CUDA-feature and workspace builds pass; `scripts/check-rust.sh` exits 101. |
| 2 | **FAIL** | All four target guards remain; loops are not consistently grid-stride. |
| 3 | **FAIL** | Direct candidate assignments remain and reduction is nonfunctional. |
| 4 | **FAIL** | Status-kernel guards remain, but the required confinement test is absent. |
| 5 | **PASS** | No tracked changes under examples, fixtures/goldens, or `docs/evidence`. |
| 6 | **FAIL** | `cargo test --locked` exits 101 with three `sembla-cuda` failures. |
| 7 | **PENDING** | No NVIDIA hardware available, as permitted by §J14.2. |
| 8 | **PENDING** | No GPU geometry run or host-side reduction test. |

`device_status()` mappings are textually unchanged, but the broken reduction means the observable error surface is not preserved.
